FN-LEOOWW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 209
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Elections
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2023
House Bill 209 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines;
increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court
costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district
attorneys, community corrections programs, the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles and the
Department of Corrections by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons
charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by the bill and the penalties imposed.

FN-LEOOWW-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 209
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 209 as reported by the Committee on State Governmental Affairs could increase
receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to
the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which
court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district
attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons
charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
